summary: Recent advancements in AI research and tools underscore their significant implications for health and science. César de la Fuente's lab at OpenAI is leveraging Codex and ChatGPT to discover new antimicrobial molecules from both living and extinct genomes, addressing the urgent challenge of drug-resistant infections. Meanwhile, Google DeepMind's AlphaGenome Atlas offers a groundbreaking genetic map that predicts the effects of 9 billion DNA variants, providing crucial insights into genetic variations. In the realm of AI startups, TrustedRouter has secured $1.25 million in funding, reflecting growing investment trends in this sector. OpenAI's introduction of the Data agent in ChatGPT Work enhances user capabilities by enabling effective data extraction and interactive dashboard creation. Additionally, tools like Diffusion PDF and Alyph are improving user experiences in image modeling and context management for large language models, respectively, highlighting the ongoing evolution of AI applications.
